description:
OVAs bundled with special editions volumes of the manga.

1. Yousei-tachi no Batsu Game
Due to the bet they made during the Grand Magic Games, the time has finally come for Team Fairy Tail A and B to decide who will have the privilege to make the other team do whatever they desire, leading to a day's worth of antics from the two parties.

2. Natsu vs. Mavis
Natsu and Erza attempt to cheer up Marvis, who has been feeling down lately.

3. Yousei-tachi no Christmas
Lucy holds a Christmas party for her friends.
